mapper.select: select so.order_id, so.inbound_detail_id, ke.final_amount, so.processed_at as sell_at, so.sell_qty, id.purchase_fx_rate, id.purchase_price from krw_exchange ke join sell_order so on so.order_id = ke.order_id join inbound_detail id on id.inbound_detail_id = so.inbound_detail_id where ke.account_id = #{accountId} and ke.settlement_status = 'FINALIZED' and so.status = 'EXECUTED' and YEAR(so.processed_at) = #{year} and #{calcBaseDateTime} >= so.processed_at
select rule_id, rule_type, rule_value, valid_from, valid_to from tax_rule

select tpj.trade_date, tpj.net_buy_amount from target_product_judgement tpj join customer c on c.ci_hash = tpj.ci_hash join account a on a.customer_id = c.customer_id where a.account_id = #{accountId} and tpj.is_target = true and YEAR(tpj.trade_date) = #{year}
mapper.insert: insert into tax_calculation (account_id, calculated_at, basis_type, sell_amount, gain_amount, gain_weighted, ext_amount, ratio, deduction, tax) values (#{accountId}, #{calculatedAt}, #{basisType}, #{sellAmount}, #{gainAmount}, #{gainWeighted},#{extAmount},#{ratio},#{deduction},#{tax})
